title: Housekeeping Standards
content: Rooms are cleaned daily between 09:00 and 15:00. Any cleanliness complaint must be addressed within 30 minutes, and guests may be offered a room change or a complimentary amenity.

title: Guest Service Recovery
content: Staff are empowered to resolve issues up to a value of 100 EUR without manager approval. Negative experiences with staff should receive a personal follow-up from the duty manager within 24 hours.

title: Check-in and Check-out
content: Standard check-in is from 15:00 and check-out until 11:00. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability and are free for loyalty members.

title: Food and Beverage Quality
content: Breakfast is served from 06:30 to 10:30. Dietary requirements (vegan, gluten-free, halal) must be accommodated on request. Complaints about food quality are escalated to the head chef.

title: Quiet Hours
content: Quiet hours are from 22:00 to 07:00. Security responds to noise complaints within 15 minutes. Guests affected by noise may be moved to a quieter room at no cost.

title: Facilities and Amenities
content: The pool and gym are open 07:00-22:00. Wi-Fi is complimentary in all areas. Maintenance issues with amenities must be logged and resolved within one business day.

title: Accessibility Commitment
content: Accessible rooms include roll-in showers and grab bars. Elevators are inspected monthly. Guests with accessibility needs are offered assistance on arrival.

title: Pricing and Value Guarantee
content: We match lower published rates for identical stays. Billing disputes are reviewed by the finance team within 48 hours.
